title: The KKH26 resultant threshold p>s^{s/2} is the SINGLE shared injectivity boundary controlling both the covering count (F4) and the Half-Sum lacunary vanishing (F10), read in opposite directions
evidence: Exact integer probes at PROPER dyadic subgroups mu_n (n=2^mu) of large prize primes q=1 mod n, q~n^4 (n=8/16/32; mu_n proper, q large). Scripts: scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C028_resultant_flip.py and probe_C028_direction.py. THREE independent refutations of C028's distinctive claim (that p>s^{s/2} is a single delicate boundary, 'the SAME resultant inequality with the inequality flipped', gating F4 and F10 as exact complements): (1) NO CROSSOVER AT THE PRIZE. s^{s/2}=(2^mu)^{2^{mu-1}} has log2 = mu*2^{mu-1}; prize p~n^beta has log2=beta*mu. Ratio thr/p in log2: n=8,beta=4 -> 0 (the only 'delicate' point = #400 small-n trap); n=16 -> 2^16x; n=32 -> 2^60x; n=2^30 (true prize) -> 2^(1.6e10)x. The prize is astronomically BELOW threshold at EVERY proper subgroup; the claimed '(2r)^{n/2} vs p delicate crossover' exists only at n=8. (2) COMPLEMENT/'FLIP' IS EMPIRICALLY FALSE. C028 predicts that below threshold (the prize side, here 2^16-2^60x below) F4 distinctness FAILS (collision polys R=P-Q vanish at g, R(g)=0) while F10 floor becomes clean -- one knob flipped. Measured: at the prize prime, F4 #vanish@g = 0 for ALL tested (n,r) (n=8,16,32; r=2,3) despite p<s^{s/2}. The size bound ||R||_1^{n/2}
honest_note: The ONLY surviving true content of C028 is the already-documented fact that p>s^{s/2} is the char-0/large-p ENVELOPE and the prize lives far below it, so the residual difficulty is char-p surplus collisions (whether short <=2*ln q-term +-1,0 relations of 2^mu-th roots vanish mod the prize prime). That is exactly DISPROOF_LOG O139 / connection C018 / the SidonModNeg cluster / the prize memory -- it welds back to W-LamLeung and adds NO new reduction. C028's distinctive assertions (a delicate flippable boundary at the prize; F4/F10 as exact complements gated by p<>s^{s/2}) are the falsified part. Probes are small-n exact (n<=32) and enumerative; the threshold arithmetic (claim 1) is rigorous for all n. No closure of the open core is claimed or achieved. Route the refuted 'shared injectivity boundary at the prize' framing to DISPROOF_LOG.
wall: W-LamLeung (char-p transfer of short +-1,0-relation vanishing of 2^mu-th roots mod the prize prime; same as DISPROOF_LOG O139 / C018 char-p surplus collisions).
